description_for_human: Documentation and reference for MML, an open source system for building multi-user interactive 3D experiences on the web.
description_for_model: MML (Metaverse Markup Language) is an open source system for building multi-user interactive 3D experiences using HTML-like elements (e.g. m-cube, m-model, m-label). Documents run on a server via Networked DOM and synchronize to clients over WebSocket. Use /llms.txt or /llms-full.txt for complete documentation.
